note: Detection dictionary for EU environmental claims (ECGT / Directive (EU) 2024/825). Severity per the triage table in docs/claims-practice/01-scan-checklist.md. rewrite_ref points at a section of docs/claims-practice/02-rewrite-library.md. exclude_context suppresses a match where the surrounding text shows compliant usage - this is what keeps the false-positive rate usable.

severities.P0: Live neutrality or offsetting claim on a consumer-reachable page. 48 hours.
severities.P1: Generic environmental claim, self-made badge, unverified label. 2 weeks.

rules.label: Carbon neutrality claim
rules.basis: ECGT Annex I: neutral/reduced/positive impact based on offsetting, blacklisted per se regardless of credit quality.

rules.label: Climate neutrality claim
rules.basis: Same prohibition, alternative wording and non-English equivalents.

rules.label: Net zero as achieved state
rules.basis: Neutrality prohibition where based on offsetting; misleading where based on nothing.

rules.label: Climate positive / carbon negative claim
rules.pattern: \bclimate[\s\-]?positive\b|\bcarbon[\s\-]?negative\b|\bnet[\s\-]?positive\b|\bgive back more than\b|\bmore than we take\b
rules.basis: Neutrality prohibition plus an effectively unevidenceable net-positive assertion.

rules.label: Plastic / water neutrality claim
rules.basis: Same structure as carbon neutrality: a neutrality claim achieved by third-party payment.

rules.label: Offsetting claim
rules.pattern: \bwe offset\b|\boffsets? (our|all|your|the|100|every)\b|\bfully offset\b|\b100% offset\b|\boffset at checkout\b|\bcarbon offsett?ing\b
rules.basis: Offsetting framing in support of an impact claim. Offering an offset purchase is not prohibited; describing the result as neutral or reduced is.

rules.label: Compensation / balancing claim
rules.basis: The neutrality prohibition in alternative wording. Not a safe synonym.

rules.label: Carbon neutral shipping or delivery
rules.basis: Service-level neutrality by offsetting. The most common live violation in EU ecommerce.

rules.label: Tree planting as impact claim
rules.pattern: \b(plant|plants|planting) a tree for every\b|\bone tree per\b|\btrees? planted for (each|every)\b|\bwe plant \d+ trees?\b
rules.basis: Implies offsetting and a permanence not evidenced. Trees planted is an input, not an outcome.

rules.label: Generic environmental claim: eco-friendly
rules.basis: ECGT: generic environmental claim without demonstrated recognised excellence.

rules.label: Generic environmental claim: sustainable as merit
rules.basis: Generic claim when used as a claim of merit. Descriptive uses ('sustainability report', 'sustainability team') are not caught.

rules.label: Generic environmental claim: regenerative / nature-positive
rules.basis: Generic claim. The word is a conclusion, not a mechanism.

rules.label: Generic environmental claim: vague virtue terms
rules.basis: Generic claim. 'Zero impact' is additionally an absolute claim that is false on its face.

rules.label: Generic environmental claim: green as merit
Possible self-created sustainability label
rules.basis: ECGT: displaying a sustainability label not based on a certification scheme or established by a public authority. Verify the scheme exists and the client is entitled to display it.

rules.label: Forward-looking target, substantiation required
rules.basis: ECGT: unsubstantiated claims about future environmental performance. Check all five tests: base year and boundary, published milestone plan, allocated resource, annual progress reporting, third-party verification where feasible.

rules.label: Vague commitment language
rules.pattern: \bcommitted to (net[\s\-]?zero|carbon neutrality|climate neutrality)\b|\bon (a|our) (journey|path|road) to net[\s\-]?zero\b|\bworking towards carbon neutral\b
rules.basis: Unsubstantiated future performance. Vaguer wording provides no additional protection.

rules.label: Comparative claim without stated basis
rules.basis: Generic wording plus a comparison with no stated basis. Requires equivalent basis, same boundary, same method.

rules.label: Undefined eco filter or product badge
rules.basis: A generic environmental claim expressed through UI with no defined criteria.

out_of_scope_flags.note: Detected and reported as observed-but-out-of-scope. Equally caught by ECGT but require materials and sector expertise. Refer to counsel; do not advise.
